name: track_progress
description:
Manage long-running work in the editor.
- Use this when a step has already been started and you now need its current status, progress, completion, or submission params recorded with the job.
- target=generation (default): track job-backed tasks such as image/video/music/TTS generation by job ID. Supports action=status, wait, params.
- If generation succeeds at the provider but asset finalization fails, the terminal entry includes an expiring recoveryUrl. Download it immediately and import the local file instead of resubmitting and spending credits again.
- target=transcription: track transcript readiness on an asset by asset ID. Supports action=status, wait.
- target=upload: report whether a cloud-readable copy is available (remoteUrl). Use it only after the next tool explicitly says it needs cloud bytes, such as pull_asset or a cloud-only render path. Do not wait preemptively: inspect_asset can read an open editor's local/blob source, and Desktop-local preview/export does not require cloud upload.
- Use track_export for submitted video/audio/cloud render jobs and export history status.
- Every call returns immediately after one status read. action=wait is a compatibility alias that also returns immediately and includes check-back guidance for non-terminal work.
- Non-terminal results include checkBackAfterSeconds. When the current task depends on completion, use your environment's sleep command (for example, Bash `sleep 30`) for at least that interval, then call action=status once. Allow at most one sleep-and-recheck cycle per turn; if it is still non-terminal, tell the user and stop. Never busy-poll. If the current task is not blocked, tell the user it is still running and stop immediately.
- target=effect: on ChatCut Desktop, inspect AI effect processing by effect item ID. Supports action=status or wait; wait is an immediate compatibility snapshot.

assetIds.description: Asset IDs or prefix IDs, comma-separated, for target=transcription or upload

effectItemIds.description: Effect item IDs or prefix IDs, comma-separated, for target=effect

jobIds.description: Job IDs or prefix IDs, comma-separated, for target=generation

target.description: Which async task kind to inspect: generation (default), transcription, upload, or Desktop effect processing
